text: Before running UMAP or t-SNE on a high-dimensional single-cell gene expression dataset, what preprocessing step does the chapter recommend?
choices: Apply PCA first and run UMAP or t-SNE on the top 30 to 50 principal components
Run DBSCAN clustering first to remove all outlier cells
Convert all expression values to z-scores and skip any further dimensionality reduction
Apply a random forest to hand-select the top 30 to 50 genes
explanation: The chapter explicitly states to 'always use PCA before UMAP/t-SNE; UMAP/t-SNE on top 30-50 PCs,' which reduces noise and computational cost before non-linear embedding. DBSCAN is a clustering method rather than a recommended preprocessing step here, z-scoring alone does not reduce dimensionality, and random-forest feature selection is not the pipeline described for this workflow.
